query: 'SELECT
    CAST(patient_id AS INT) AS patient_id,
    CAST(full_name AS NVARCHAR(250)) AS full_name,
    CAST(gender AS VARCHAR(10)) AS gender,
    CASE
        WHEN parsed_dob < '1900-01-01' OR parsed_dob > '2026-11-22' THEN NULL
        ELSE parsed_dob
    END AS date_of_birth,
    CAST(phone AS VARCHAR(50)) AS phone,
    CAST(email AS VARCHAR(255)) AS email,
    CAST(address AS NVARCHAR(500)) AS address,
    CAST(insurance_provider AS NVARCHAR(150)) AS insurance_provider
FROM (
    SELECT
        LTRIM(RTRIM(patient_id)) AS patient_id,
        LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(full_name, N'Â', N''))) AS full_name,
        CASE
            WHEN LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(gender))) IN ('m', 'male') THEN 'Masculino'
            WHEN LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(gender))) IN ('f', 'female') THEN 'Femenino'
            ELSE 'Otro'
        END AS gender,
        CASE
            WHEN TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LTRIM(RTRIM(date_of_birth)), 23) IS NOT NULL
                THEN TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LTRIM(RTRIM(date_of_birth)), 23)
            WHEN LTRIM(RTRIM(date_of_birth)) LIKE '[0-9][0-9]/[0-9][0-9]/[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]'
                THEN TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LTRIM(RTRIM(date_of_birth)), 101)
            WHEN LTRIM(RTRIM(date_of_birth)) LIKE '[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(RIGHT(LTRIM(RTRIM(date_of_birth)), 2) AS INT) BETWEEN 28 AND 49
                        THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -100, TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LTRIM(RTRIM(date_of_birth)), 10))
                    ELSE TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LTRIM(RTRIM(date_of_birth)), 10)
                END
            ELSE TRY_PARSE(LTRIM(RTRIM(date_of_birth)) AS DATE USING 'en-US')
        END AS parsed_dob,
        CASE
            WHEN phone IS NULL OR LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(phone))) = 'unknown' THEN NULL
            ELSE LTRIM(RTRIM(phone))
        END AS phone,
        CASE
            WHEN email IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(LTRIM(RTRIM(email)), ' at ', '@'), 'gmial.com', 'gmail.com'), ',com', '.com'))
        END AS email,
        LTRIM(RTRIM(address)) AS address,
        CASE LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(insurance_provider)))
            WHEN 'aetna' THEN 'Aetna'
            WHEN 'aetnaa' THEN 'Aetna'
            WHEN 'aetna inc.' THEN 'Aetna'
            WHEN 'bluecross' THEN 'BlueCross'
            WHEN 'blue cross' THEN 'BlueCross'
            WHEN 'blue-cross' THEN 'BlueCross'
            WHEN 'cigna' THEN 'Cigna'
            WHEN 'cigna health' THEN 'Cigna'
            WHEN 'medicaid' THEN 'Medicaid'
            WHEN 'medicare' THEN 'Medicare'
            WHEN 'medi-care' THEN 'Medicare'
            WHEN 'self pay' THEN 'Self-Pay'
            WHEN 'self-pay' THEN 'Self-Pay'
            WHEN 'unitedhealth' THEN 'UnitedHealth'
            WHEN 'united health' THEN 'UnitedHealth'
            WHEN 'uhc' THEN 'UnitedHealth'
            ELSE 'Sin Seguro'
        END AS insurance_provider,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(full_name, N'Â', N''))), date_of_birth, LTRIM(RTRIM(address))
            ORDER BY CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(patient_id)) AS INT)
        ) AS rn
    FROM bronze.patients
) AS t
WHERE rn = 1',
